outcome: Gross Motor Function Classification System (GMFCS) level
Pediatric Evaluation of Disability Inventory (PEDI) scores
International Classification of Functioning, Disability, and Health for Children and Youth with CP (ICF-CY-CP) Core Sets scores
cohort: The study included 37 children up to 12 years old with Cerebral Palsy who were assisted at the Physiotherapy Clinic for Motor Rehabilitation of the Clinical Hospital of the University of Campinas.
finding: The study found severe motor impairment among children with CP, with 65% classified at GMFCS levels IV and V, and noted that parents had a realistic perception of their children's functionality, with common perinatal complications including low birth weight, prematurity, and neonatal anoxia.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from children with CP up to 12 years old, with an average age of 7 years, at the time of assessment.
birth_weight: 61% of children were born at a low weight.
gest_age: 36% of cases were extreme or very premature births.
